text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D10","page":1,"quote":"-0.009"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D11","page":1,"quote":"-0.025"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"2) # HARD CHROME PLATING 20 TO 30 MICRONS, HARDNESS 850 TO 1000 HV."}],"comment":"The Ø42 g6 shaft section (feature F11, defined by limits D10/D11 with a 0.016 mm tolerance band) is hard chrome plated per note N2, but the drawing does not state whether the g6 limits apply before or after plating. Without this allowance the plated shaft will be oversize and will not achieve the intended fit. The designer should add a note specifying that the g6 tolerance applies after plating, or provide pre-plate machining dimensions that account for the 20–30 µm coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'g6 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify undersize pre-plate dimensions to accommodate the 20–30 µm chrome layer."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"NOTE :- 1) $ TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 40-45 HRC."}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies heat treatment (toughened to 40–45 HRC) but does not state at which manufacturing stage it must be performed relative to machining, grinding, or plating. This omission matters because applying heat treatment at the wrong stage can distort finished features or destroy surface treatments. The designer should revise the note to define the sequence, for example 'TOUGHEN TO 40–45 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL GRINDING.'","recommended_correction":"Update note N1 to specify the manufacturing stage at which the heat treatment applies."}]}
